Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the central Washington state fair as the official state fair.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the central Washington state fair asthe official state fair; adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The central Washington state fair is designated as the officialstate fair of the state of Washington.

Section 1 of this act does not create anyrights or add to any existing right, nor does it operate to infringeupon any existing name of any fair in the state. Section 1 of this actmay not be relied upon to compel the establishment or expansion of anyprogram, funding, or special entitlement.
